::: {.left}

I'm a computational biologist with eight years of industry experience in biotech R&D — building reproducible pipelines, turning complex NGS data into decisions, and collaborating with experimental and computational scientists in synthetic biology, gene therapy, and gene editing. My core strengths are high-throughput screening, metagenomics, genome assembly, single-cell RNA-seq, and variant characterization. At Amber Bio I used machine learning to optimize RNA editing constructs for stability, activity and specificity. 

I'm currently looking for my next role in Bay Area biotech or pharma. This blog is a way for me showcase my research side-projects with foundation models and pyTorch in an NDA-friendly way. 

Everything here runs on a single 4080 and public data — I build for efficiency by necessity. Give me more powerful hardware and more interesting data, and let's see what's possible. Reach out.

[← Check out my projects here](../)

:::
